part.text:
I did not find the red ball, and the robot is not near it. I called `rest`, so it is now crouched with its motors off.

- **What I saw:** I did a full sweep of the room from the start position and found no red ball. The only red object was a red lid on a tank by the heater on the right, which is not a ball.
- **Where it got stuck:** I walked forward to look further ahead and ended up against a large black case. The robot's collision protection then blocked almost every move, forward, backward, sideways and turning. I tried more than ten small moves and turns with almost no progress.
- **Why I stopped:** I was not going to find the ball from this position. I rested the robot rather than force it into the case.

To continue, someone would need to move the robot a short way from the case, ideally to its right, where the floor is open. I can then search again from there.
